Name: Greens and Callaloo
Author: HellaGayJaime
Description:
[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]
When you harvest [b]Carrot[/b], [b]Beet[/b], [b]Radish[/b], and [b]Yam[/b], you will also get [b]Greens[/b], similar to getting Hay from Wheat. 

[b]Greens[/b] only sell for 20g. However, they randomly roll quality from normal to gold when harvested. You can pickle and juice them, but I suggest selling them fresh, keeping the normal quality ones for [b]Rice & Greens[/b].

[b]Rice & Greens[/b] is technically profitable with a small margin, but it is intended to be a recipe you can spam out to use as combat food. [b]It heals for 112 health[/b].

When you harvest [b]Amaranth [/b]and [b]Taro[/b], you will also get [b]Callaloo[/b]. It drops with the same mechanics as greens, with a base value of 55g.

At Combat 10, you can use two Callaloo and many other ingredients to make [b]Island Stew[/b], an endgame food with several good buffs. Island Stew is loved by Leo.

Lastly, the crop texture for Amaranth has been recolored so that its foliage is green, like Jamaican amaranth. You only see purple when the grains are ready to harvest, which has a more striking visual effect with the contrast. This recolor is enabled by default and can be changed with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] or by editing config.json (in this mod's folder).

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
Unzip in your \Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods folder.
Do the same for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] if you haven't already. You need these for most Stardew mods.
Lastly, do the same for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22975]Machine Terrain Framework.[/url]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Major thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/zombifier]Selph[/url] for Machine Terrain Framework, updating their mod to make bonus crop drops roll quality, and being so helpful in the discord.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]The inclusion of Callaloo and Island Stew (Ital Stew) was inspired by [url=https://www.youtube.com/@feedandteach]Feed & Teach[/url].[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]Thanks to ConcernedApe for making this game. The sprites in this mod are edits of vanilla sprites.[/color]
